title: 出行与服务词汇
goal: 理解出行与服务词汇，根据服务用语判断办理事项。

points.label: 识别出行服务词汇的含义
根据服务用语判断办理事项

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 出行服务词汇范围与课程小测规格

body.p: 本课词汇分四类：交通换乘、住宿预订、餐饮点单、购物退换。订位、付款和取消各用不同的动词。

body.box: I'd like to make a reservation. / I'd like to cancel my reservation.

body.p: make a reservation 是预订。cancel my reservation 是取消已经订好的预订。

cards.title: 词汇表：交通换乘
rows: Transfer to a bus at the next station.
We waited on the platform for the train.
Check the timetable for the next train.
The passenger paid the bus fare.
The bus takes a route through the town.
The departure time is printed on the ticket.
The board shows the arrival time.
The train delay lasted twenty minutes.
Maya bought a ticket at the station.
The bus reached its destination at noon.

cards.title: 词汇表：住宿预订
rows: Lee made a reservation for two nights.
They booked a room near the station.
A room is available on Friday.
办理入住；check in at a hotel
We checked in at the hotel at six.
办理退房；check out of a hotel
Guests check out of the hotel by noon.
Ask at reception for another key.
Each hotel guest receives a key.
Ari reserved a single room for Monday.
Please confirm the booking by email.
She canceled her reservation on Tuesday.

cards.title: 词汇表：餐饮点单
rows: We asked for the bill after dinner.
The guests looked at the menu.
They ordered a meal at the counter.
I booked a table for four.
The menu includes a vegetable dish.
The restaurant serves lunch at noon.
Ask the waiter for the menu.
The menu lists the ingredients in the soup.
Nora ordered a drink with her meal.
They left a tip after the meal.

cards.title: 词汇表：购物退换
rows: The customer requested a refund for the bag.
She exchanged the jacket for a larger size.
Keep the receipt in case the size is wrong.
He returned the item to the shop.
The customer asked for a larger size.
They paid in cash at the counter.
I paid by card for the shoes.
The assistant checked the price of the coat.
The assistant helped a customer with a return.
The shop offered a replacement for the damaged lamp.

items.stem: Passengers transfer to a bus at Hill Station. What do they do?
options: They wait for a later bus.
items.why: transfer to a bus 表示换乘公交车。

items.stem: Mia made a hotel reservation. What did she do?
options: She checked out of a room.
She booked a room in advance.
She paid for a hotel room.
items.why: made a reservation 表示预订。

items.stem: The diners asked for the bill. What did they request?
The customer requested a refund. What did the customer want?
options: A larger size of the item
A receipt for the same item
The money paid for the item

items.stem: The guest canceled the booking. What happened?
items.why: canceled the booking 表示取消预订。

items.stem: The passenger checked the departure time. What did the passenger check?
options: The time the train would leave
The price of the train ticket

lines.text: I'd like to book a table for four on Saturday evening. Is there space near the window, away from the restaurant entrance?
Yes. I can reserve that table for seven.

items.stem: What service is the customer requesting?
options: Paying the bill for a meal
Asking for a seat by the entrance
items.why: I'd like to book a table 表示预订餐桌，即第三项。顾客要的是窗边，离入口远。

lines.text: This jacket is too small. I bought it yesterday and kept the receipt. Could I exchange it for a larger size?
Certainly. I'll check whether that size is available.

options: A refund for a larger jacket
A smaller size of the same jacket
The jacket in a larger size
items.why: exchange it for a larger size 表示换成大一码的夹克，即第四项。顾客要换货，不要退款。

items.stem: Passengers transfer to a train at Central Station. What do they do?
options: They wait for a later train.
items.why: transfer to a train 表示换乘火车。

items.stem: The guest made a hotel reservation. What did the guest arrange?
items.why: make a reservation 表示提前预订。

items.stem: The guests asked for the bill after dinner. What did they ask for?
items.why: bill 指需要支付的餐费账单。

items.stem: The shop gave a refund for the lamp. What did it give?
options: The money paid for the lamp

items.stem: The passenger checked the timetable. What did the passenger check?
options: The price of the train ticket
The route taken by the train

items.stem: The customer exchanged the shoes for a larger size. What happened?
options: The customer requested a cash refund.
The customer kept the original shoes.
items.why: exchanged the shoes for a larger size 表示把原来的鞋换成大一码的鞋，即第二项。

lines.text: I have a reservation for a single room on Friday, but my plans have changed. Could you cancel the booking, please?
Certainly. I'll cancel the Friday reservation and send you a confirmation.

items.stem: What does the guest ask the hotel to do?
items.why: Could you cancel the booking 是请酒店取消周五已订的单人间，即第三项。

options: A bill for the Friday room
A receipt for the original booking
items.why: I'll cancel the Friday reservation and send you a confirmation 说明酒店取消后会发确认，即第四项。

lines.text: These shoes don't fit. I bought them yesterday and have the receipt. Could I get a refund instead of exchanging them?
Yes. I'll return the payment to your card if you show me the receipt.

options: A receipt for a new purchase
items.why: Could I get a refund instead of exchanging them 表示要退款，不换货，即第一项。

options: The card used for the payment
items.why: if you show me the receipt 说明要出示买鞋的收据，即第二项。card 是退款打回的地方。
